name: Haus Handle
beschreibung:
The Haus Handle in Grins lies on a sun terrace above the Inntal and offers a quiet starting point for activities in the region.

The holiday apartments are equipped with a kitchenette, seating area and bedrooms; some have a balcony or terrace.

No dining facilities are provided in the house, but several inns can be found in the village center of Grins.

The surroundings are suitable for extensive hikes and mountain bike tours that start directly from the house.

In winter, the Venet ski areas in Zams and the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region can be reached by car in a short time.

The quiet, sunny location away from through traffic shapes the relaxed atmosphere of the house.
